text.tspan: Rakeback is a partial refund to users of the
commission that the poker room charges from
the total pot. Rakeback is credited to the user's
The amount of rakeback depends on your VIP
status level in poker. Your VIP status level is
determined by the number of VIP Points you
have accumulated. Every $1 of rake from your
bets earns you one VIP Point. Players' VIP
statuses are reset on the first of September
The expected rakeback amount can be found in
the in-game menu of the poker room.
